nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Amazon product discovery and potential bestseller mining via Nexscope data. Triggered when users mention product mining, potential bestsellers, high-conversion product selection, click growth analysis, market growth opportunities, keyword-based product selection, FBA profit screening, niche market product discovery, seller origin filtering, Nexscope data, FBA profitability screening, keyword-based product selection. Even if users do not explicitly mention "Nexscope", this skill should be triggered whenever the task involves keyword-driven Amazon product selection based on conversion rates, click volume, and profitability metrics.

clickConversionRateCompositeMax.description: Maximum composite conversion rate, value range 0-1, 0.1 means 10%

clickConversionRateCompositeMin.description: Minimum composite conversion rate, value range 0-1, 0.1 means 10%

clickConversionRateMax.description: Maximum click-to-purchase conversion rate, value range 0-1, 0.1 means 10%

clickConversionRateMin.description: Minimum click-to-purchase conversion rate, value range 0-1, 0.1 means 10%

clickCountGrowthT30Max.description: Maximum monthly click growth rate, value range 0-1, 0.1 means 10%

clickCountGrowthT30Min.description: Minimum monthly click growth rate, value range 0-1, 0.1 means 10%

clickCountGrowthT7Max.description: Maximum weekly click growth rate, value range 0-1, 0.1 means 10%

clickCountGrowthT7Min.description: Minimum weekly click growth rate, value range 0-1, 0.1 means 10%

countryCode.description: Country, use country abbreviation. Default US. Options: US, JP, DE

keyword.description: Keyword (required; translate the keyword to the language of the selected country)

sellerCountry.description: Seller country/region code, comma-separated for multiple selections, e.g.: CN,US

sortField.description: Sort field. Default purchasedClicksT360. Options: totalReviews (total reviews), price (price), launchDate (listing time), clickCountT7 (7-day click count), clickCountT30 (30-day click count), clickCountT90 (90-day click count), clickConversionRate (click-to-purchase conversion rate), clickConversionRateComposite (composite click-to-purchase conversion rate), customerRating (rating), purchasedClicksT360 (360-day purchase clicks), clickCountGrowthT7 (weekly click growth rate), clickCountGrowthT30 (monthly click growth rate), currentPrice (current price), fbaFee (FBA fee), shippingFee (FBA shipping), gpm (gross profit margin)

sortType.description: Sort direction. Default desc. Options: desc (descending), asc (ascending)
